answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 35611 Country: India Title: If during nightfall the pajama is smeared with napaki and the blanket has no sign of napaki in the morning Question: If during nightfall the pajama is smeared with napaki and the blanket has no sign of napaki in the morning. Please tell me it is necessary to wash the blanket? Answer ID: 35611 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1903/1348/L=1432) If one is not sure of the impurity in the blanket then it is not necessary to wash it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
